pages.title: lithofacies_architecture_v5r1
pages.description: Redraw a fixed-nine lithofacies framework. Left: aligned well-log window X∈R^(B×35×33), missing-modality mask, vertical stratigraphic order. The dominant blue operational path is center values + window statistics + local gradients → XGBoost multi-softprob trees → nine logits s_c(x) → softmax → fixed 9-class probability vector → Depth/TWT class sequence. The orange research path is a separate controlled ablation: window → interpolation 33→512 → patch embedding → MOMENT transformer encoder. Split this encoder into pretrained and random-init conditions with identical nine-class heads. Both orange conditions end at one gray Pretraining-effect comparator containing ΔMacro-F1, ΔmIoU, ΔNLL placeholders without numbers. The comparator must not connect to the operational probability vector or class sequence. Bottom rail: LOGO4 mother-well split → class weighting → multi-seed training → fixed-nine metrics. Add an Evaluation bracket spanning the blue operational output and the orange comparator, but no box or arrow labeled Fusion.
